explanation: Handel lived in London, but Messiah opened at a charity concert in Dublin in April 1742. Ladies were asked to leave their hooped skirts at home to make room.

claims.text: Handel's Messiah had its first performance in Dublin, in April 1742.
Messiah did not premiere in London, Hamburg or Rome.
Handel was based in London when Messiah premiered.
The Dublin premiere of Messiah was a charity concert.
Ladies were asked not to wear hooped skirts to the premiere so that more people could fit in.

Rival test: argued for London, where Handel lived and where Messiah is most associated, which is the trap; Hamburg and Rome are cities of his early career. The first performance was in Dublin on 13 April 1742, so the key stands. Volatility: evergreen; no time words, and nothing depends on knowledge newer than mid-2026. Regional: Messiah is performed worldwide, especially its Hallelujah chorus, and the Dublin premiere surprises players everywhere. Style: Oxford spelling, straight quotes, no en or em dashes, explanation within 35 words. Myths: screened against myths.json, no hit. Mystery: not applicable to a practice item.
